properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-core's inference module; the eigenvariable half added 2026-10-18 (fact:root-cause-the-generalization-check-read-only-fixes-and-never-the-assumptions-open-at-the-step-2026-10-18). `Inference.generalizes_over` (add_inference) names the variables a step generalizes over; Requirement, Constraint and Verification carry `variables` (what a record mentions) and `fixes` (what it binds to one value, as `name=value` or a bare name). A step generalizing over v does not hold while (a) any record it rests on, at any depth (assumed premises included), fixes v, or (b) an assumption still OPEN at the step (assumed beneath it, discharged neither by it nor by a step on the way; the step's own discharges and cases close first) NAMES v — its `variables` or `fixes` lists v — or declares no `variables` at all, which leaves the question unanswerable (an empty list declares it names none). Its verdict then reads `unknown` with the reason, so its conclusion is unsupported, never refuted; the step's reading carries `generalization` (over, holds, fixed_by, named_by_open_assumptions, undeclared_open_assumptions, mentioned_by), and each such step is a `reasoning_not_as_stated` gap. Structural, not a logic: the same name is the same variable. Trial shapes: Euclid's "for an arbitrary finite list L"; Arrow's conditional proof over F (discharge, then generalize, in one step: valid).
properties.name: A step generalizes over a declared variable, and reflow2 checks that no premise beneath it fixes the variable and no assumption still open at it names it
